section_header: EMISSION CONTROL SYSTEMS — Fuel Evaporative Emission Control (EVAP) System
title: FUEL EVAPORATIVE EMISSION CONTROL (EVAP) SYSTEM

content.description: Schematic diagram of EVAP system showing fuel vapor flow path from fuel tank through charcoal canister to intake manifold

content.text: To reduce HC emission, evaporated fuel from the fuel tank is routed through the charcoal canister to the intake manifold for combustion in the cylinders

rows: HC from tank is absorbed in the canister.
HC from tank is absorbed in the canister.
HC from canister is led into air intake chamber.

(Air is led into the fuel tank.)

content.text: INSPECTION OF FUEL VAPOR LINES, FUEL TANK AND FILLER CAP

content.description: Illustration showing fuel vapor lines and connections routing from fuel tank to canister and purge port

items:
VISUALLY INSPECT LINES AND CONNECTIONS
Look for loose connections, sharp bends or damage.

VISUALLY INSPECT FUEL TANK
Look for deformation, cracks or fuel leakage.

content.description: Detailed illustration of fuel filler cap showing internal check valve (vacuum valve) and gasket

items:
VISUALLY INSPECT FUEL FILLER CAP
Check condition of gasket and cap.
If necessary, repair or replace the cap.
